correctness.rationale: Exact degree-block reduction and positive moment representation are checked. The Fourier integral for multinomial collision has unique nondegenerate maximum, determinant product of weights and Gaussian Laplace coefficient. Positive trace diagonals give trace transitions and logarithmic constant. Dyadic singular-value estimates of B^{1/2} give every p>1 for exactly two primes, while nontrace excludes p<=1. Weakly null blocks rule out one-prime compactness. Executed finite checks support constants, not infinite proof.
